scope: Supplementary sampled image review, not the automated Archify browser gate and not a full accessibility audit

index.result: No blocking overlap, horizontal clipping or broken hierarchy observed in captured first screen
index.limits: Below-fold material not visually inspected; muted small labels should not be treated as a full contrast/accessibility pass

diagram_samples.result: Main nodes and relationship labels contained; no unrelated-node crossings or obvious overlaps observed
diagram_samples.limits: Small supporting text has lower visual contrast; lower explanatory cards continue below viewport; other theme/viewport captures not perceptually inspected

diagram_samples.result: Main nodes and relationship labels contained; cwd and actual access isolation are visibly distinguished
diagram_samples.limits: Small muted text is less prominent; lower explanatory cards continue below viewport; other theme/viewport captures not perceptually inspected

automatic_browser_evidence: Use artifact-bound browser-check receipts; do not infer it from this review
